name: Jobs for Mums
notes: Employer page lists listing packages at $99, $129 and $299, plus services from $2,000 and from $30 per hour. Currency is shown only as $. Partnerships page offers partnership packages for employers and recruitment agencies. No API is mentioned. The /api and /developers paths returned 404.

review.note: Employer page states listing prices and partnerships page exists; footer shows Auckland New Zealand but no headquarters statement; no language options or parent stated.
